title: Not All Ranks Are Equal: Budget-Aware LoRA Merging Across Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Merging low-rank adapters (LoRAs) promises to eliminate the overhead of swapping task-specific weights at inference time. However, existing merging methods assume every layer needs the same rank budget. Further, some methods assume that rank budget needs to be split equally among the tasks too. We show this uniform-budget assumption is a major source of the performance gap between merged and per-task LoRAs. However, rank selection is an NP hard problem. To this end, we introduce Net Utility, a data free metric that first decomposes every task LoRA by its Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and scores each of those singular directions by its task utility and its interference with other tasks directions. Next, we globally pool these scores to select singular directions with the highest values with a constraint on the total number of directions selected. translated_title: 并非所有秩都是平等的：跨任务的预算感知LoRA合并
translated_abstract: 合并低秩适配器（LoRA）有望消除推理时交换任务特定权重的开销。然而，现有的合并方法假设每一层都需要相同的秩预算。此外，一些方法还假设秩预算需要在任务之间平均分配。我们证明这种统一预算的假设是合并LoRA与每个任务单独LoRA之间性能差距的主要来源。然而，秩选择是一个NP难问题。为此，我们引入了Net Utility，这是一个无需数据的度量指标，它首先通过奇异值分解（SVD）对每个任务的LoRA进行分解，然后根据每个奇异方向的任务效用及其与其他任务方向的干扰程度对这些方向进行评分。接下来，我们在选定方向总数受约束的条件下，全局汇集这些分数以选择分值最高的奇异方向。所提出的Net Utility度量被应用于五种不同的合并方法之上……
tldr: 提出Net Utility这一无需数据的度量指标，通过SVD分解、任务效用与干扰评分以及全局池化选择，实现了预算感知的LoRA合并，突破了传统统一秩预算假设的性能瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes Net Utility, a data-free metric for budget-aware LoRA merging that scores singular directions via SVD decomposition based on task utility and cross-task interference, then globally selects the best directions under a budget constraint, overcoming the performance gap caused by uniform rank budget assumptions.
